_comment: Wraps maxhyper.dtquark.worldgen.LushCavesAzaleaFeature (registered as dtquark:lush_caves_azalea via DTQuarkFeatures DeferredRegister). The feature uses NoneFeatureConfiguration so config is empty. The Java side internally walks SubterraneanGroundFinder layers and calls Species.generate on dtquark:azalea — bypassing DT's BiomeDatabase populator entirely so adult azaleas appear inside lush_caves without poking the populator path that triggers Species.reset() and breaks bonemeal globally.
